method: Isolated temporary project with copied city source and minimal Session/Settings stubs. Calls _generate without adding city node to tree. No full game or player saves accessed.
normal_seeds: 1–100 inclusive for each of small, medium, large
no_water_seeds: 1–100 inclusive for each of small, medium, large; disable_water=true before _generate; terrain RNG sequence differs from normal
connectivity: Four-neighbour flood fill, including bridge road cells. Water components count all river/lake cells; disconnected diagonal cells may touch at corners visually.
building_access_caveat: No direct road adjacency is diagnostic only; no path-based access claim. Unserved blocks have no road-adjacent cell; this does not measure connection to main road network.
park_definition: At least one deco cell exactly equal to park. Paths and other green decoration do not satisfy this measure.
existing_checks: All8 existing city_checks.gd checks passed on copied source. Test performs only a few fixed-seed cases and does not enforce global connectivity.
